title: Mike Evans thought he'd easily break the record for consecutive 1,000-yard seasons in 2025

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Mike Evans thought he'd easily break the record for consecutive 1,000-yard seasons in 2025
sources.description: In 2024, 49ers receiver Mike Evans set a record in Tampa by becoming the first player with 11 straight 1,000-yard receiving seasons to start a career.
